newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gillette rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gillette rated a buy.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw analyst reiterated the buy rating for Gillette Co based on strong trends, particularly in the U.S. blade and razor market.
-- maintains estimates of $2.21 per share for fiscal year 1996, and $0.61 per share for the fourth quarter.

-- said projecting double-digit top and bottom line gains for the full year 1997, assuming a nearly 12 percent increase in sales to $8.4 billion and a 20.5 percent increase in earnings per share to $2.65 per share.
-- analyst was not immediately available to comment.
